name: Daily orders
spec: SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS day, count(*) FROM orders GROUP BY 1

name: Average basket size
spec: SELECT avg(total_cents)/100.0 FROM orders WHERE created_at > now() - interval '30 days'

name: Robot uptime by site
spec: SELECT site, avg(uptime_pct) FROM telemetry GROUP BY site ORDER BY 2 DESC

name: Fault codes this week
spec: SELECT code, count(*) FROM faults WHERE ts > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY 1

name: MRR by region
spec: SELECT region, sum(mrr_cents)/100.0 FROM subscriptions GROUP BY region

name: Overdue deliverables
spec: SELECT client, count(*) FROM deliverables WHERE due_on < current_date AND status <> 'done' GROUP BY 1

name: Public uptime 30d
spec: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, avg(uptime_pct) FROM status_checks GROUP BY 1
